parameters.name: ImageURLA
parameters.description: The URL of image A. We recommend that you use an Object Storage Service (OSS) link in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS link outside the Shanghai region, see [File URL processing](~~155645~~).

parameters.name: ImageURLB
parameters.description: The URL of image B. We recommend that you use an OSS link in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS link outside the Shanghai region, see [File URL processing](~~155645~~).

parameters.name: QualityScoreThreshold
parameters.description: The quality score threshold for face image quality analysis. If the quality score of a face is lower than this threshold, a MessageTips field is added to the response.
